title: Checkout timeouts after payment-gateway retry-timeout tuning
root_cause: A deploy reduced the payment-gateway client timeout from 5s to 1s to shave checkout latency; the gateway's p95 legitimately sits above 1s under load, so the shorter timeout turned slow-but-valid calls into hard failures.
resolution: Reverted the timeout to 5s, added a circuit breaker around the gateway client, and added an alert on gateway p95 latency approaching the configured timeout.

title: Auth-service outage after JWT signing key rotation
root_cause: New signing key was rotated in without a grace period accepting both old and new keys, invalidating all outstanding tokens instantly.
resolution: Added dual-key verification during rotation windows; rotations now overlap old/new keys for 24h before the old key is retired.

title: Search latency spike from synonym expansion feature
root_cause: Newly launched synonym expansion made an uncached external dictionary lookup on every query.
resolution: Added a local cache for synonym lookups and a feature flag to disable expansion under load.

title: Cascading failures from payments-service SDK upgrade
root_cause: A minor SDK version bump changed the shape of error response bodies, breaking downstream error parsing.
resolution: Pinned the SDK version, added contract tests against the gateway's error response schema.

title: Rate limiting misconfiguration blocked legitimate checkout traffic
root_cause: A rate limit meant for a single abusive client was applied globally to the /v1/checkout route.
resolution: Scoped the rate limit to client IP + API key instead of the route, added a dashboard for rate-limit rejections by route.

title: Notification delivery delays during SMTP relay outage
root_cause: Upstream SMTP relay provider had a regional outage; no fallback relay was configured.
resolution: Added a secondary SMTP relay with automatic failover.

title: Checkout cart total mismatch on currency rounding
root_cause: Rounding was applied per line item instead of on the final total, compounding small errors.
resolution: Moved rounding to a single pass on the final total; added a reconciliation test comparing cart total to charge amount.

title: Envoy sidecar upgrade caused intermittent connection resets
root_cause: New Envoy version changed default keepalive settings, causing premature connection resets under moderate load.
resolution: Pinned keepalive settings explicitly instead of relying on Envoy defaults; added canary rollout for sidecar upgrades.
